fields.objection: A single Gaussian RMS is diluted by the full sphere area. Reflector dish RMS, core-to-face fit, peak contour error and one localized dimple are not interchangeable.
fields.proposed_fix: Specify defect amplitude, footprint and spatial spectrum; scan actual geometry and pass it to the shell model. Keep one-dimple RMS explicitly conditional.
